name: setup
what: Setup merges the hooks into a project's settings without losing anything already there, adds each only once, and refuses a damaged file untouched.

faults.fault: A hook already in place is added again on every run.
Existing hooks in the project are replaced instead of kept.
Other settings in the file are dropped.
A file that is not valid JSON is overwritten as if it were empty.
A dry run still writes the file.
An unknown hook name given to --only is ignored instead of refused.
